title: Tenma Saki — Appreciation Overflow!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, that dress and jacket combo is so cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Seeing them together on a mannequin like this helps a ton.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Thanks to Kanade, I have a way better idea of what sort of outfit to choose...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But now I need to actually find the right clothes. This might end up being the hardest part of all.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want some frilly and cute clothes like the ones at this shop...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I don't have anything like this at home. What do I do...?
Huh? Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku! Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! What a coincidence!
Are you two out shopping together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We actually just ran into each other.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, at the sewing lounge.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you getting some clothes shopping done, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I was actually just looking at the outfits on these mannequins.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Their outfits?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes. The thing is, for art class...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like such a fun project...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I could spend hours and hours picking outfits and hairstyles for that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Coming up with outfits for Kanade to wear and ways to do up her hair has been so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know what I want to do now, but I don't have the clothes to make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's after I borrowed some from Ichi and the girls. I still don't have everything I need.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I see what you mean...
Buying clothes for just one project is a bit of a tough sell.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... I wanted to try a bunch of different outfits and choose the best one, but I probably have to start whittling down my options.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, what do you have in mind at the moment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Umm... I saved pictures of those outfits to my phone the other day... Oh, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's these...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I own a blouse like this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That also goes for this skirt. It's not quite the same color, but the design is very similar.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be more than happy to help you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I don't want you to give up on your ideas before even getting a chance to try them out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You mean that...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and I may have other clothes that you can use. I'll take some pictures and send them to you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're the best, Shizuku...! Thank you so much!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm just glad that I can help you in some way, Saki. Does that cover what you need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, it would be nice to also have some cute clothes like the ones this shop carries...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I've got that covered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I actually visit this shop a lot!
In fact, we were just on our way to stop here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. They got a few really cute accessories in recently, and I wanted to recommend some to Shizuku♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, does that mean you have outfits like the ones they have in the front window?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do!
Ask for whatever you need since I really wanna see Kanade wear these kinds of clothes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...!
I might actually be able to get everything I need now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
Send me the pic once it's ready, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like a copy as well! That is, if it's okay with you and Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! I'll ask Kanade the next time I see her!
